sensors.name: Accelerometer
sensors.measures: Linear acceleration along one or more axes
sensors.why: Machines and vehicles needed to detect movement, tilt and shock without external references.
sensors.uses: Drone stabilization, phone screen rotation, machine vibration monitoring.
sensors.when: Use when linear motion, impact or tilt must be measured.
sensors.example: A 3-axis MEMS accelerometer detects a sudden landing impact.

sensors.name: Gyroscope
sensors.measures: Angular rate about one or more axes
sensors.why: Navigation systems needed to measure rotation between position updates.
sensors.uses: Flight stabilization, gimbals, robotics joints, navigation.
sensors.when: Use when angular motion must be measured quickly.
sensors.example: A flight controller uses gyro rates to damp roll and pitch.

sensors.name: 6-axis IMU
sensors.why: Robots needed compact motion sensing for attitude estimation.
sensors.uses: Flight controllers, handheld controllers, balancing robots.
sensors.when: Use when acceleration and rotation are both needed; combine with filtering/fusion.
sensors.example: An IMU such as BMI088 supplies accelerometer and gyro data.

sensors.name: 9-axis IMU
sensors.measures: Acceleration, angular rate and magnetic field
sensors.why: Standalone orientation systems needed a heading reference in addition to motion sensing.
sensors.uses: Drone attitude estimation, robotics, wearable orientation.
sensors.when: Use when a compact fused orientation solution is useful; calibrate magnetic effects.
sensors.example: A 9-axis module combines accel, gyro and magnetometer.

sensors.name: Magnetometer / electronic compass
sensors.why: Navigation needed a direction reference when visual landmarks or GPS were unavailable.
sensors.uses: Drone heading, robot navigation, compass instruments.
sensors.when: Use for heading aiding; keep away from motors, power wiring and magnets.
sensors.example: A compass helps estimate yaw outdoors.

sensors.name: Tilt switch
sensors.measures: Whether a device has crossed a tilt threshold
sensors.why: Simple equipment needed low-cost orientation or tip-over detection.
sensors.uses: Equipment safety, tamper detection, toy devices.
sensors.when: Use for a threshold event, not precise angle measurement.
sensors.example: A tilt switch turns off a machine when tipped.

sensors.name: Inclinometer
sensors.measures: Angle relative to gravity or a reference plane
sensors.why: Construction and machinery needed repeatable slope/level measurement.
sensors.uses: Robot chassis leveling, platform alignment, structural monitoring.
sensors.when: Use when static or slow tilt angle matters.
sensors.example: An inclinometer checks whether a rover mast is level.

sensors.name: Vibration sensor (MEMS)
sensors.why: Maintenance teams needed early warning of rotating machinery faults.
sensors.uses: Motor health, propeller imbalance, industrial predictive maintenance.
sensors.when: Use when vibration signatures indicate looseness, imbalance or bearing wear.
sensors.example: A MEMS sensor flags a damaged drone motor mount.

sensors.name: Shock / impact sensor
sensors.why: Products and machines needed to record mishandling or collision events.
sensors.uses: Package monitoring, crash logging, robot collision records.
sensors.when: Use for event detection; select range and bandwidth for expected impact.
sensors.example: A logger records a hard drone landing.

sensors.name: Angular rate / rate sensor
sensors.measures: Rate of rotation, often in a dedicated axis
sensors.why: Control systems needed direct rate feedback for damping and stabilization.
sensors.when: Use when control loops need angular-rate feedback.
sensors.example: A yaw-rate sensor provides feedback to a stabilizing controller.

sensors.name: Ultrasonic distance sensor
sensors.why: Robots needed inexpensive non-contact ranging in simple environments.
sensors.uses: Obstacle avoidance, tank level, parking assistance.
sensors.when: Use for low-cost short/medium range where sound reflections are acceptable.
sensors.example: A rover slows when an ultrasonic sensor sees a wall.

sensors.name: Infrared reflective proximity sensor
sensors.measures: Nearby object from reflected IR intensity
sensors.why: Small robots needed compact, inexpensive object detection.
sensors.uses: Line-following robots, edge detection, short-range presence.
sensors.when: Use for short-range detection; performance depends on surface color and ambient IR.
sensors.example: A line follower detects a dark strip on a bright floor.

sensors.name: Time-of-Flight (ToF) optical sensor
sensors.measures: Distance from emitted light travel time or phase
sensors.why: Compact electronics needed more direct distance measurement than reflectance sensors.
sensors.uses: Drone near-field ranging, robot docking, presence detection.
sensors.when: Use for precise short-range distance in suitable lighting and target conditions.
sensors.example: A ToF module measures distance to a landing pad.

sensors.name: Scanning LiDAR
sensors.measures: Laser ranges across angles to build a 2D/3D point cloud
sensors.why: Autonomous systems needed geometric maps and obstacle distance beyond a single beam.
sensors.uses: SLAM, mapping, autonomous vehicles, inspection robots.
sensors.when: Use when geometric depth over a wider field of view is needed.
sensors.example: A rover maps a corridor with a 2D LiDAR.

sensors.name: Single-point laser rangefinder
sensors.measures: Distance along a narrow laser beam
sensors.why: Surveying and automation needed accurate point distance without contact.
sensors.when: Use when one measured direction is sufficient.
sensors.example: A downward laser rangefinder estimates drone height above a surface.

sensors.name: Inductive proximity sensor
sensors.measures: Presence of conductive/metal objects via electromagnetic field change
sensors.why: Factories needed reliable non-contact metal detection in dirty environments.
sensors.uses: Machine automation, end-stop detection, metal part counting.
sensors.when: Use for metal targets; not general-purpose object detection.
sensors.example: A CNC machine detects a metal fixture at a limit position.

sensors.name: Capacitive proximity sensor
sensors.measures: Change in capacitance caused by nearby material
sensors.why: Automation needed detection of non-metal objects and liquid/solid levels.
sensors.uses: Plastic part detection, fill-level sensing, touch interfaces.
sensors.when: Use for many materials, but tune for humidity and material variation.
sensors.example: A sensor detects plastic pellets in a hopper.

sensors.name: Hall-effect proximity sensor
sensors.measures: Magnetic field from a magnet or magnetic target
sensors.why: Systems needed sealed, contactless switching and position sensing.
sensors.uses: Motor commutation, wheel speed, lid detection.
sensors.when: Use with a magnet or magnetic field source.
sensors.example: A Hall switch detects each rotor magnet pass.

sensors.name: Photoelectric through-beam sensor
sensors.measures: Object interrupts a light beam between emitter and receiver
sensors.why: Factories needed reliable high-speed object counting.
sensors.uses: Conveyor counting, safety gates, presence detection.
sensors.when: Use when emitter and receiver can be mounted opposite each other.
sensors.example: A beam counts packages on a belt.

sensors.name: Radar ranging sensor
sensors.measures: Range and often radial velocity using radio waves
sensors.why: Vehicles needed robust sensing in darkness, fog, dust and some weather.
sensors.uses: Collision warning, drone research, vehicle perception.
sensors.when: Use when optical sensing is degraded; interpret multipath and target limitations.
sensors.example: A radar module detects a moving object in a test lane.

sensors.name: FMCW mmWave radar
sensors.measures: Range, velocity and angle from frequency-modulated continuous waves
sensors.why: Automotive and industrial systems needed simultaneous range and velocity sensing in poor visibility.
sensors.uses: Occupancy sensing, obstacle detection, gesture sensing, robotics research.
sensors.when: Use for motion/range in darkness, dust or fog; validate small-target performance.
sensors.example: A 60-GHz radar detects a moving person behind light obscurants.

sensors.name: Doppler radar sensor
sensors.measures: Motion and radial speed from Doppler frequency shift
sensors.why: Automatic systems needed motion detection without contact.
sensors.uses: Intrusion sensing, speed measurement, motion-triggered systems.
sensors.when: Use when motion is the key signal rather than detailed shape.
sensors.example: A Doppler module triggers a light when movement occurs.

sensors.name: Pulse radar altimeter
sensors.measures: Height above ground from radio pulse timing
sensors.why: Aircraft needed altitude measurement independent of barometric altitude near the ground.
sensors.uses: Low-altitude aircraft, terrain following, aerospace test rigs.
sensors.when: Use when radio-altitude measurement is needed and certified integration is possible.
sensors.example: An aircraft radio altimeter reports height above terrain.

sensors.name: UWB ranging sensor
sensors.why: Indoor systems needed more precise ranging than conventional RSSI positioning.
sensors.uses: Indoor robot localization, asset tracking, formation experiments.
sensors.when: Use with anchors/tags and surveyed geometry.
sensors.example: A robot estimates its position from four UWB anchors.

sensors.name: RFID reader / sensing interface
sensors.measures: Tag identity and sometimes sensor-tag telemetry
sensors.why: Supply chains needed automatic identification without line-of-sight scanning.
sensors.uses: Inventory, tool tracking, access control, sensor-tag experiments.
sensors.when: Use for identification and traceability, not direct environment measurement unless tag is sensor-enabled.
sensors.example: A workshop logs which battery pack was checked out.

sensors.name: NFC proximity interface
sensors.measures: Very short-range inductive coupling and data exchange
sensors.why: Devices needed secure, simple tap-based configuration or identification.
sensors.when: Use for intentional close-proximity interaction.
sensors.example: A technician taps an NFC tag to load a drone maintenance profile.

sensors.name: RSSI radio signal sensor
sensors.why: Wireless systems needed a rough signal-strength metric.
sensors.when: Use only for coarse estimates; multipath makes it a poor precision range sensor.
sensors.example: A robot detects that a beacon signal is getting weaker.

sensors.name: Spectrum / RF power detector
sensors.measures: RF energy or power across a frequency band
sensors.why: Radio engineers needed to monitor emissions and interference.
sensors.uses: RF lab, antenna tuning, transmitter diagnostics.
sensors.when: Use for RF measurements with a suitable calibrated front end.
sensors.example: A lab monitors 5.8-GHz video transmitter output.

sensors.name: RF direction-finding sensor
sensors.measures: Direction of arrival of radio signals
sensors.why: Search and rescue and spectrum teams needed to locate transmitters.
sensors.when: Use with antenna arrays and calibrated phase/amplitude channels.
sensors.example: A field team locates an interference source.

sensors.name: Passive microwave radiometer
sensors.why: Earth observation needed remote measurement of atmospheric and surface properties.
sensors.when: Use for specialized remote sensing, not ordinary embedded robotics.
sensors.example: A satellite estimates atmospheric water vapor.

sensors.name: Thermistor
sensors.why: Electronics needed low-cost temperature measurement for compensation and protection.
sensors.uses: Battery, motor, ESC and enclosure temperature.
sensors.when: Use for low-cost point temperature sensing over a suitable range.
sensors.example: An NTC monitors battery temperature during charging.

sensors.name: RTD temperature sensor
sensors.why: Industry needed stable, accurate temperature measurement.
sensors.uses: Calibration equipment, industrial processes, thermal chambers.
sensors.when: Use when accuracy/stability outweigh cost and response-time tradeoffs.
sensors.example: A PT100 measures a test chamber temperature.

sensors.name: Thermocouple
sensors.measures: Temperature from thermoelectric voltage at junctions
sensors.why: High-temperature processes needed rugged measurement over wide ranges.
sensors.when: Use for wide/high-temperature ranges; manage cold-junction compensation.
sensors.example: A K-type probe measures a motor test rig exhaust.

sensors.name: Digital temperature IC
sensors.measures: Temperature converted to digital data on-chip
sensors.why: Embedded products needed simple temperature readings without analog calibration.
sensors.uses: PCB temperature, ambient monitoring, electronics protection.
sensors.when: Use for board-level temperature with simple I2C/SMBus integration.
sensors.example: A digital sensor monitors an AI compute module.

sensors.name: Capacitive humidity sensor
sensors.why: Buildings and products needed compact humidity monitoring.
sensors.uses: Weather stations, storage, electronics enclosure monitoring.
sensors.when: Use for ambient humidity; avoid condensation and contamination.
sensors.example: A sensor warns when a drone storage box is too humid.

sensors.name: Dew-point sensor
sensors.measures: Dew point or moisture condensation risk
sensors.why: Industrial and building systems needed prediction of condensation.
sensors.uses: Optics enclosures, compressed air, storage rooms.
sensors.when: Use when condensation risk matters more than RH alone.
sensors.example: A test chamber checks dew point before cold-soak testing.

sensors.name: Barometric pressure sensor
sensors.why: Altimeters and weather instruments needed pressure-based altitude and weather trends.
sensors.when: Use for relative altitude and pressure trends; compensate drift and weather changes.
sensors.example: A flight controller estimates climb from pressure changes.

sensors.name: CO2 NDIR sensor
sensors.measures: Carbon dioxide concentration using infrared absorption
sensors.why: Indoor spaces needed direct ventilation/air-quality measurement.
sensors.when: Use for indoor CO2; allow warm-up and airflow access.
sensors.example: A classroom ventilation controller responds to elevated CO2.

sensors.name: VOC gas sensor
sensors.measures: Volatile organic compounds or aggregate VOC index
sensors.why: Air-quality systems needed indication of chemical vapors and indoor pollution.
sensors.uses: Indoor air monitoring, leak screening, process monitoring.
sensors.when: Use as a screening indicator; identify gas-specific needs before safety decisions.
sensors.example: A sensor detects rising solvent vapor in a workshop.

sensors.name: Particulate matter sensor
sensors.why: Air-quality monitoring needed quantitative airborne particle estimates.
sensors.uses: Dust monitoring, clean rooms, pollution studies.
sensors.when: Use with airflow and inlet design suited to the environment.
sensors.example: A workshop measures fine dust near a CNC machine.

sensors.name: Electrochemical CO sensor
sensors.why: Safety systems needed selective low-power toxic-gas detection.
sensors.when: Use for CO-specific alarms with certified calibration and placement.
sensors.example: A detector warns of CO accumulation.

sensors.name: Electrochemical NO2 sensor
sensors.why: Environmental monitoring needed pollutant-specific measurement.
sensors.when: Use for NO2 monitoring with cross-sensitivity correction.
sensors.example: A station measures traffic-related NO2.

sensors.name: Electrochemical ozone sensor
sensors.why: Industrial and environmental systems needed ozone exposure monitoring.
sensors.when: Use when ozone is present or generated by equipment.
sensors.example: A lab monitors ozone around a UV treatment unit.

sensors.name: Oxygen sensor
sensors.why: Combustion and life-support systems needed oxygen feedback.
sensors.uses: Medical equipment, combustion control, industrial safety.
sensors.when: Use with technology matched to gas, range and safety requirements.
sensors.example: A controller maintains oxygen concentration in a chamber.

sensors.name: Hydrogen sensor
sensors.why: Hydrogen systems needed early leak detection due to flammability.
sensors.uses: Fuel-cell labs, battery rooms, hydrogen test rigs.
sensors.when: Use near likely leak points with certified safety design.
sensors.example: A fuel-cell bench detects a hydrogen leak.

sensors.name: Methane sensor
sensors.why: Gas utilities needed leak detection for flammable gas.
sensors.when: Use for methane-specific detection and proper alarm thresholds.
sensors.example: A service robot surveys a methane test area.

sensors.name: LPG sensor
sensors.measures: Propane/butane gas presence or concentration estimate
sensors.why: Domestic and industrial spaces needed detection of fuel-gas leaks.
sensors.uses: Kitchen safety, gas storage, test labs.
sensors.when: Use for LPG leak warning; low-cost metal-oxide modules are not certified life-safety devices.
sensors.example: A prototype alerts when LPG rises near a test cylinder.

sensors.name: Ammonia sensor
sensors.why: Agriculture and refrigeration needed exposure/leak monitoring.
sensors.uses: Cold storage, fertilizer facilities, livestock buildings.
sensors.when: Use when ammonia is a known hazard; select range and materials carefully.
sensors.example: A refrigeration room monitors ammonia leakage.

sensors.name: pH electrode
sensors.why: Water and chemical processes needed acidity/alkalinity measurement.
sensors.uses: Water quality, hydroponics, chemical process control.
sensors.when: Use in liquids with calibration buffers and temperature compensation.
sensors.example: A hydroponics controller maintains nutrient-solution pH.

sensors.name: Ion-selective electrode
sensors.measures: Specific ion activity, e.g. fluoride, nitrate or potassium
sensors.why: Analytical chemistry needed selective ion measurement without lab chromatography.
sensors.when: Use for a target ion with calibration and interference control.
sensors.example: A soil lab measures nitrate in an extract.

sensors.name: LDR / photoresistor
sensors.why: Simple circuits needed inexpensive light-responsive control.
sensors.uses: Automatic lamps, basic light meters, educational projects.
sensors.when: Use for coarse ambient-light thresholds, not calibrated measurements.
sensors.example: A streetlight turns on at dusk.

sensors.name: Photodiode
sensors.why: Optical systems needed fast and measurable light detection.
sensors.uses: IR receivers, optical encoders, light meters.
sensors.when: Use for fast/linear light detection with appropriate amplifier.
sensors.example: A photodiode reads an optical encoder disk.

sensors.name: Phototransistor
sensors.why: Low-cost electronics needed amplified light detection.
sensors.uses: Object counters, optical switches, reflective sensors.
sensors.when: Use when simplicity and sensitivity matter more than high speed/linearity.
sensors.example: A counter detects a rotating slotted wheel.

sensors.name: Ambient light sensor
sensors.why: Displays and devices needed automatic brightness control.
sensors.uses: Screen brightness, smart lighting, camera exposure assistance.
sensors.when: Use when human-visible ambient brightness is relevant.
sensors.example: A controller dims a display indoors.

sensors.name: RGB color sensor
sensors.measures: Red, green and blue intensity components
sensors.why: Automation needed color classification without a full camera.
sensors.when: Use for controlled lighting and close-range color detection.
sensors.example: A conveyor sorts colored caps.

sensors.name: Color temperature sensor
sensors.measures: Correlated color temperature and sometimes illuminance
sensors.why: Lighting systems needed to characterize warm/cool white light.
sensors.when: Use when white-light quality matters.
sensors.example: A luminaire adjusts from warm to cool white.

sensors.name: UV sensor
sensors.why: Outdoor and industrial products needed UV exposure measurement.
sensors.uses: UV curing, solar exposure, safety monitoring.
sensors.when: Use for a specified UV band and calibrated irradiance.
sensors.example: A curing machine checks UV lamp output.

sensors.name: IR thermopile sensor
sensors.measures: Non-contact surface temperature from infrared radiation
sensors.why: Devices needed temperature measurement without touching a surface.
sensors.uses: Thermal screening, motor surface monitoring, appliances.
sensors.when: Use for spot temperature; emissivity and field-of-view matter.
sensors.example: A robot checks motor housing temperature.

sensors.name: Thermal imaging array
sensors.why: Systems needed spatial heat patterns without visible light.
sensors.when: Use for thermal scene understanding; calibrate and respect resolution limits.
sensors.example: A drone research payload finds overheated electrical connectors.

sensors.name: CMOS image sensor
sensors.why: Digital vision required compact, low-power image capture.
sensors.uses: FPV camera, stereo vision, AI perception, inspection.
sensors.when: Use for visual perception; select shutter, dynamic range, lens and interface.
sensors.example: A stereo pair feeds a depth-estimation pipeline.

sensors.name: CCD image sensor
sensors.why: Scientific and imaging systems needed high image quality and low noise.
sensors.when: Use in specialized low-noise imaging where CCD tradeoffs are justified.
sensors.example: A scientific camera images faint stars.

sensors.name: Global-shutter CMOS sensor
sensors.measures: Image with all pixels exposed at nearly the same time
sensors.why: Fast-moving scenes needed reduced rolling-shutter distortion.
sensors.uses: FPV motion perception, robotics, machine vision.
sensors.when: Use for rapid motion and visual odometry; check resolution and frame rate.
sensors.example: A drone camera avoids skew when a propeller moves across frame.

sensors.name: Rolling-shutter CMOS sensor
sensors.why: Consumer imaging needed efficient, low-cost high-resolution capture.
sensors.when: Use when cost/resolution dominate and motion artifacts are acceptable.
sensors.example: A stationary inspection camera records a scene.

sensors.name: Event-based vision sensor
sensors.measures: Pixel-level brightness-change events with microsecond timing
sensors.why: Conventional frames struggled with high dynamic range and fast motion.
sensors.uses: High-speed robotics, research navigation, low-latency tracking.
sensors.when: Use for fast motion and sparse event processing; requires specialized algorithms.
sensors.example: A robot tracks a fast ball under flickering light.

sensors.name: Multispectral sensor
sensors.why: Agriculture and remote sensing needed material/vegetation information beyond RGB.
sensors.uses: Crop health, material classification, environmental monitoring.
sensors.when: Use when target spectral bands are known and calibrated.
sensors.example: A drone maps crop stress using red-edge and NIR bands.

sensors.name: Hyperspectral sensor
sensors.why: Research needed detailed spectral signatures for material identification.
sensors.uses: Mineral mapping, food quality, environmental research.
sensors.when: Use when spectral discrimination justifies data, cost and compute.
sensors.example: A lab identifies minerals from spectral signatures.

sensors.name: Spectrometer
sensors.why: Science needed wavelength-resolved measurement instead of a single light value.
sensors.uses: Material analysis, LED testing, chemical analysis.
sensors.when: Use when spectrum shape is the measurement.
sensors.example: An engineer measures LED spectral output.

sensors.name: Laser displacement sensor
sensors.measures: Precise displacement from triangulation or interferometry
sensors.why: Manufacturing needed non-contact dimensional inspection.
sensors.uses: Robotics calibration, CNC inspection, vibration measurement.
sensors.when: Use for precision surface/displacement measurement at controlled range.
sensors.example: A sensor checks a machined part thickness.

sensors.name: Fiber-optic sensor
sensors.measures: Strain, temperature or vibration inferred through optical fiber changes
sensors.why: Harsh/high-voltage environments needed electrically isolated sensing.
sensors.uses: Structural monitoring, power equipment, aerospace research.
sensors.when: Use where EMI immunity or distributed sensing is important.
sensors.example: A fiber sensor monitors strain on a composite wing.

sensors.name: Polarization sensor
sensors.why: Vision systems needed material/texture cues not obvious in intensity images.
sensors.uses: Glare reduction, surface inspection, navigation research.
sensors.when: Use for polarization-specific scene cues.
sensors.example: A robot distinguishes reflective surfaces from diffuse ones.

sensors.name: Strain gauge
sensors.why: Structures needed direct measurement of load and deformation.
sensors.uses: Load cells, wing flex tests, structural health monitoring.
sensors.when: Use when strain or stress inference is required; bridge conditioning is needed.
sensors.example: A strain gauge measures FPV arm flex under thrust.

sensors.name: Load cell
sensors.why: Scales and machines needed repeatable force measurement.
sensors.uses: Thrust stand, battery weighing, robotic gripping.
sensors.when: Use for calibrated force/weight; select capacity and overload rating.
sensors.example: A drone thrust stand measures motor thrust.

sensors.name: Force-sensitive resistor (FSR)
sensors.why: Products needed thin, inexpensive pressure/contact sensing.
sensors.uses: Grip detection, buttons, seat occupancy prototypes.
sensors.when: Use for relative force/contact, not precision metrology.
sensors.example: A gripper detects whether it has touched an object.

sensors.name: Piezoelectric force sensor
sensors.measures: Charge/voltage generated by dynamic mechanical stress
sensors.why: Systems needed fast transient force and vibration detection.
sensors.when: Use for dynamic events; static force measurement is generally unsuitable.
sensors.example: A sensor detects a propeller strike on a test fixture.

sensors.name: Capacitive tactile array
sensors.why: Robots needed touch localization over a surface.
sensors.when: Use when contact location and pressure pattern matter.
sensors.example: A gripper maps where an object touches its fingers.

sensors.name: Torque sensor
sensors.why: Machines needed direct feedback on transmitted torque.
sensors.uses: Motor testing, robotic joints, drivetrain evaluation.
sensors.when: Use when torque rather than motor current is the required quantity.
sensors.example: A dynamometer measures motor output torque.

sensors.name: Shear force sensor
sensors.why: Robots needed slip and manipulation feedback.
sensors.when: Use when lateral force/slip is important.
sensors.example: A gripper detects an object beginning to slide.

sensors.name: Pressure mapping film/sensor array
sensors.why: Ergonomics and manufacturing needed contact-pressure visualization.
sensors.uses: Seat testing, gripper design, assembly fixtures.
sensors.when: Use for spatial pressure mapping; consider calibration and durability.
sensors.example: Engineers map pressure across a drone battery strap.

sensors.name: MEMS barometric differential sensor
sensors.why: HVAC and flow systems needed compact differential pressure sensing.
sensors.when: Use for low differential pressure with suitable porting and range.
sensors.example: A test rig measures pressure drop across a duct.

sensors.name: Hydraulic pressure transducer
sensors.why: Industrial equipment needed electronic monitoring of hydraulic loads.
sensors.when: Use in hydraulic circuits with compatible wetted materials.
sensors.example: A robot arm monitors hydraulic pressure.

sensors.name: Rotary potentiometer
sensors.why: Controls needed simple analog position feedback.
sensors.when: Use for low-cost absolute position over limited rotation.
sensors.example: A test gimbal measures stick angle.

sensors.name: Linear potentiometer
sensors.why: Machines needed simple linear travel measurement.
sensors.when: Use for moderate precision and limited travel.
sensors.example: A linear actuator reports extension.

sensors.name: Incremental rotary encoder
sensors.why: Motors and machines needed speed and relative position feedback.
sensors.when: Use when a reference/home position can be established.
sensors.example: A rover counts wheel rotations.

sensors.name: Absolute rotary encoder
sensors.measures: Unique digital/analog code for each shaft angle
sensors.why: Machines needed position immediately after power-up without homing.
sensors.when: Use when absolute angular position is required.
sensors.example: A gimbal reports its angle after startup.

sensors.name: Linear optical encoder
sensors.measures: Linear displacement from optical scale and readhead
sensors.why: Machine tools needed precise axis measurement.
sensors.when: Use for high-resolution linear feedback in clean/controlled installations.
sensors.example: A CNC axis closes its position loop.

sensors.name: Magnetic encoder
sensors.measures: Position from magnetic scale or rotating magnet
sensors.why: Machines needed compact, robust position feedback tolerant of dust/oil.
sensors.uses: Motor shaft, wheel odometry, actuator feedback.
sensors.when: Use where optical encoders are vulnerable to contamination.
sensors.example: A wheel encoder measures rover travel.

sensors.name: LVDT
sensors.why: Industry needed rugged, frictionless precision displacement measurement.
sensors.when: Use for accurate linear displacement with AC conditioning.
sensors.example: A test stand measures suspension travel.

sensors.name: RVDT
sensors.why: Industrial systems needed rugged angular position sensing.
sensors.when: Use for limited-angle precision feedback.
sensors.example: An actuator reports control-surface angle.

sensors.name: Reed switch position sensor
sensors.why: Equipment needed simple sealed end-stop detection.
sensors.when: Use for binary position state, not continuous position.
sensors.example: A drone detects whether a battery door is closed.

sensors.name: Hall-effect linear position sensor
sensors.measures: Magnetic field strength/orientation mapped to position
sensors.why: Contactless systems needed wear-free position feedback.
sensors.when: Use with controlled magnet geometry and calibration.
sensors.example: A controller reads a magnetic joystick axis.

sensors.name: GPS receiver
sensors.measures: Position, velocity and time from GPS satellites
sensors.why: Outdoor navigation needed global coordinates and time.
sensors.when: Use outdoors with sky view; not reliable as sole indoor or close-obstacle sensor.
sensors.example: A drone records its flight path.

sensors.name: Multi-constellation GNSS
sensors.measures: Position using GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou and others
sensors.why: Receivers needed better satellite availability and geometry.
sensors.when: Use when availability and robustness matter.
sensors.example: A rover uses multiple constellations in a tree-lined field.

sensors.name: RTK GNSS rover
sensors.why: Surveying and autonomy needed accuracy beyond standalone GNSS.
sensors.when: Use with base/network corrections, good sky view and validated integrity.
sensors.example: A drone logs centimeter-class survey points.

sensors.name: GNSS compass / dual-antenna heading
sensors.measures: Heading from the baseline between GNSS antennas
sensors.why: Vehicles needed heading even while stationary or at low speed.
sensors.uses: Autonomous rover, marine and UAV research.
sensors.when: Use when magnetic interference is severe and antenna spacing is practical.
sensors.example: A rover obtains heading from two GNSS antennas.

sensors.name: GNSS timing receiver
sensors.measures: Precise time reference from satellite signals
sensors.why: Telecom and distributed systems needed synchronized clocks.
sensors.uses: Sensor timestamping, multi-camera synchronization, test labs.
sensors.when: Use for timing synchronization with antenna visibility.
sensors.example: A test rig aligns logs from multiple devices.

sensors.name: Visual odometry camera
sensors.measures: Motion estimate from changes between images
sensors.why: Robots needed motion estimates where wheel slip or GPS loss occurs.
sensors.when: Use with texture, lighting and calibrated camera; combine with IMU.
sensors.example: A drone estimates forward movement from image features.

sensors.name: Visual-inertial odometry module
sensors.why: Robots needed robust motion tracking during rapid movement.
sensors.when: Use when visual and inertial data complement each other.
sensors.example: A VIO module estimates a drone trajectory indoors.

sensors.name: Optical flow sensor
sensors.why: Small robots needed ground-relative velocity without full visual SLAM.
sensors.uses: Drone position hold, rover speed estimation.
sensors.when: Use over textured surfaces and within height/lighting limits.
sensors.example: A downward flow sensor helps a drone hold position.

sensors.name: UWB localization tag
sensors.measures: Ranging to fixed anchors for indoor position
sensors.why: GNSS-denied spaces needed local coordinate positioning.
sensors.when: Use with surveyed anchors and line-of-sight-aware deployment.
sensors.example: A robot localizes in a warehouse using UWB anchors.

sensors.name: Magnetic localization sensor array
sensors.measures: Local magnetic field signatures for position/orientation
sensors.why: Robots needed localization in constrained spaces without GPS.
sensors.when: Use only where magnetic map is stable and calibrated.
sensors.example: A robot follows a mapped magnetic field signature.

sensors.name: Voltage divider monitor
sensors.why: Embedded controllers needed safe measurement of voltages above ADC range.
sensors.when: Use for DC voltage within divider and ADC accuracy limits.
sensors.example: A flight controller reads 6S battery voltage.

sensors.name: Shunt current sensor
sensors.measures: Current from voltage drop across a precision resistor
sensors.why: Power systems needed direct current measurement.
sensors.uses: Battery monitor, ESC bench testing, power profiling.
sensors.when: Use when accuracy is needed and insertion loss/heat are acceptable.
sensors.example: A shunt measures propulsion current.

sensors.name: Hall-effect current sensor
sensors.measures: Current inferred from magnetic field around conductor
sensors.why: Systems needed isolated or low-loss current measurement.
sensors.uses: Battery monitoring, motor phase current, power electronics.
sensors.when: Use when isolation and low insertion loss matter.
sensors.example: A module measures battery current without a series shunt.

sensors.name: Current transformer
sensors.why: Power distribution needed isolated AC current monitoring.
sensors.when: Use for AC, not steady DC current.
sensors.example: A panel meter monitors AC feeder current.

sensors.name: Rogowski coil
sensors.measures: AC current from induced voltage proportional to di/dt
